flagged.evidence: Step 3.1 says, “So clause 3 applies to every such K, which is exactly the stated minimality.” This proves only that L^* is contained in each concatenation-closed K containing L and ε. The stated leastness also requires L^* itself to be concatenation-closed, but the preceding clause 2 establishes only LL^*⊆L^*, not L^*L^*⊆L^*. A short induction using clause 2 supplies the missing fact.

The cited definition says only that the comparison witnesses are “polynomials p,q:N→N” and imposes no monotonicity condition. Step 1.2 infers m(x)≤p(q(|x|_τ)) from m(x)≤p(|x|_σ) and |x|_σ≤q(|x|_τ), which requires p to be nondecreasing. For example, p(t)=(t-1)^2 maps N to N but 0≤1 while p(0)=1>0=p(1). Replacing p by a monotone polynomial majorant repairs the proof.
